### Question 1

Suppose a lab instrument loses 12% of its value each year. Its current value is 1800$. Compute its value after
4 years

```{r cars}
V = 1800*(1-0.12)^4
V
```

### Question 3
Create a vector of temperatures using c():
72, 75, 71, 68, 70, 74, 77, 73.
Then use indexing to extract:
1. the first temperature,
2. the last three temperatures,
3. all temperatures except the fourth,
4. all temperatures at least 74.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
temperature = c(72,75,71,68,70,74,77,73)
# the first temperature
temperature[c(1)]
# the last three temperature
temperature[c(6:8)]
# all temperatures except the fourth
temperature[c(-4)]
# all temperature at least 74
temperature>=74 # need to change this

```
